description: Land Acquisition - Megoda Diyathura, Ibbagamuwa D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is a declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of specific land parcels for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of multiple land lots with their boundaries, extents, and ownership claims. The content focuses exclusively on land matters (acquisition, boundaries, ownership) without involving government personnel changes, structural changes, or any other specialized categories. The mention of the Minister is purely procedural as the issuing authority for land acquisition declarations, not the focus of the content.
